status.nb: 20 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 36 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Israeli forces fired across the border into southern Syria, killing a Syrian man with disabilities in the Daraa buffer zone and deploying rooftop snipers who opened fire in the south. Syrian security officers were killed in a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus. In a separate operation, Syrian forces targeted an ISIS cell in Rankous, resulting in the deaths of two Syrian security personnel. The conflict continued to involve cross-border Israeli strikes and Syrian government counter-terror actions. The war caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker skjøt over grensen inn i sørlige Syria, og drepte en syrisk mann med funksjonsnedsettelser i Daraa-buffersonen, samt satte opp taksnikere som åpnet ild i sør. Syriske sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept i et raid på en ISIL-celle nær Damaskus. I en separat operasjon målrettet syriske styrker en IS-celle i Rankous, noe som førte til at to syriske sikkerhetspersonell ble drept. Konflikten fortsatte med grenseoverskridende israelske angrep og syriske regjerings-antiterror-aksjoner. Krigen forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
